about: NIP-CK reader vectors. Every checklist reader (buzz-cli, stall-judge, buzz-vim core) loads this file and must produce `expect` for each case. Readers trust the relay for signatures; owner and watcher are given below. Regenerate with gen.js; never hand-edit an event. `defaults` are the production defaults (owner = lucian, watcher = the fleet watcher seat); every reader asserts its built-in defaults equal them. The cases use the test keys in `owner`/`watchers`.

cases.name: one_driver_all_versions
cases.why: creator keeps both versions; newest wins

cases.name: one_driver_pruned
cases.why: relay kept only the newest version; same answer

cases.name: squatter_signs_creators_address
cases.why: judgebot repro: X signs a version of A's header (d names A) between A's versions; X is ignored

cases.name: squatter_newer_on_creators_address
cases.why: a newer version of A's header by X changes nothing

cases.name: second_list_is_contested
cases.why: X starts its own header (backdated before A's): no first-come, the channel is contested until the owner picks

cases.name: owner_picks
cases.why: the owner signs a version of A's header: A drives, owner's version is the newest

cases.name: creator_edits_after_owner
cases.why: A edits after the owner: A's newer version shows

cases.name: owner_newest_pick_wins
cases.why: the owner's newest header version names the driver

cases.name: owner_drives
cases.why: the owner can be the driver

cases.name: items_only_driver_or_owner
cases.why: A's item stands against X's newer done-flip; X's and B's own items are not on A's list; the owner's item is

cases.name: owner_edits_item
cases.why: the owner's version of A's item is newer than A's

cases.name: creator_edits_item_after_owner
cases.why: A's later version beats the owner's

cases.name: no_header_no_list
cases.why: items without an accepted header show nothing

cases.name: contested_hides_items
cases.why: a contested channel shows no items until the owner picks

cases.name: malformed_ignored
cases.why: d channel != h, a creator segment that is not a key, a type that disagrees with the kind, a bad item id: all ignored (so they cannot contest)

cases.name: watch_only_from_watcher
cases.why: the watcher's record stands; X's newer one is ignored

cases.name: noncanonical_header_d_ignored
cases.why: uppercase creator hex, an npub creator, extra segments: ignored even from the key they name, so they cannot contest; an owner version at an uppercase address is ignored too

cases.name: h_d_mismatch_ignored
cases.why: X's header names this channel in d but was sent to another channel (h, channel tag); ignored here

cases.name: noncanonical_item_d_ignored
cases.why: items with an uppercase creator, extra segments or the old creator-less address are ignored

cases.name: contested_not_running
cases.why: two ideating headers: contested, but nothing runs, so no ping

cases.name: contested_one_running
cases.why: one of the two contesting headers runs: contested_running

cases.name: owner_switches_driver
cases.why: the owner picked X, then B: X's items disappear, B's appear

cases.name: owner_switch_before
cases.why: same channel before the switch: X drives with its items

cases.name: driver_edit_newer_than_owner_pick
cases.why: the owner picked A at 400; A edits at 500 and X edits its own header at 700: A's content shows and A still drives

cases.name: owner_item_at_non_driver_address_hidden
cases.why: the owner's item version at X's address while A drives stays hidden
